# Daroodi Luxury Bespoke Haute Couture

> Founded in 1982 in Lahore, Pakistan, Daroodi is a heritage haute couture maison specializing in hand-embroidered royal Prince Coats, Sherwanis, bespoke velvet Tuxedo blazers, and ceremonial fraternal regalia.

## Key Sections & Pages

- [Homepage](https://daroodi.com/): Official flagship digital atelier showcasing handcrafted luxury formalwear.
- [Collections](https://daroodi.com/collections): Explore the 4 tiers of craft — Platinum, Gold, Silver, and Essentials.
- [Shop All Masterpieces](https://daroodi.com/shop): Browse our full catalog of handcrafted coats, blazers, and bespoke pieces.
- [Bespoke Custom Orders](https://daroodi.com/custom-order): Commission a one-of-a-kind garment tailored to your measurements.
- [Bulk & Events](https://daroodi.com/bulk-events): Custom group tailoring for weddings, delegations, and formal galas.
- [Our Heritage](https://daroodi.com/our-heritage): The history and generational artisan craft behind Daroodi.
- [Atelier Archive](https://daroodi.com/atelier-archive): Historical archive of master needlework techniques and royal commissions.
- [Journal](https://daroodi.com/journal): Sartorial guides, wedding style advice, and embroidery craftsmanship essays.
- [Track Order](https://daroodi.com/track-order): Live atelier production tracking from pattern drafting to DHL delivery.
- [Size & Measurement Guide](https://daroodi.com/size-guide): Comprehensive guide to bespoke measurements and custom fit.
- [Shipping Policy](https://daroodi.com/shipping): Worldwide insured courier transit information.
- [Refund Policy](https://daroodi.com/refund-policy): Alteration guarantee and returns policy.
- [FAQ](https://daroodi.com/faq): Answers to frequently asked questions about orders and tailoring.
- [Contact Concierge](https://daroodi.com/contact): Direct consultation with our master stylists.
- [Sitemap](https://daroodi.com/sitemap): Complete directory of all store pages and collections.

## Core Haute Couture Collections

- [Platinum Royal Collection](https://daroodi.com/collections#platinum): Heirloom-grade velvet, crystal accents, and 120–160 hours of Zardozi needlework.
- [Gold Heritage Collection](https://daroodi.com/collections#gold): Rich metallic threadwork and botanical motifs on wool, velvet, and brocade.
- [Silver Modern Formal Collection](https://daroodi.com/collections#silver): Geometric embroidery and Art Deco lines for evening elegance.
- [Essentials Everyday Luxury](https://daroodi.com/collections#essentials): Quality wool and cotton blends with focused artisan accents.

## Featured Masterpieces

- [Men's Premium Prince Coat](https://daroodi.com/shop/mens-premium-prince-coat): Imperial dark green damask with intricate hand-embroidered mandarin collar.
- [Taupe Longline Embroidered Tuxedo Coat](https://daroodi.com/shop/premium-taupe-longline-embroidered-tuxedo-coat): Knee-length duster with copper bronze Zardozi bullion.
- [Burgundy Wool Blazer — Gold Collar](https://daroodi.com/shop/burgundy-wool-blazer-gold-collar): Rich crimson wool with celestial collar embroidery.
- [Black Brocade Tuxedo Jacket](https://daroodi.com/shop/black-brocade-tuxedo-jacket): Handwoven brocade with pure silk peak lapel.
- [Ivory White Linen Blazer](https://daroodi.com/shop/ivory-white-linen-tailored-blazer): Pure linen with artisanal leaf sleeve embroidery.
- [Black Blazer — Art Deco Silver](https://daroodi.com/shop/black-blazer-silver-art-deco): Super 140s wool with geometric silver metallic tilla work.
- [Gold Floral Wool Blazer](https://daroodi.com/shop/black-wool-blend-tailored-blazer-gold-floral): Tailored wool blazer with botanical bullion lapel needlework.
- [Navy Blue Slim Suit Coat](https://daroodi.com/shop/mens-navy-blue-slim-suit-Coat): Tailored Italian wool blend with discreet artisan cuff accents.
